verdict.rationale: Qdrant's security docs describe three API key types: Admin, Read-Only, and Granular Access. The granular keys scope read/write access per collection, which covers the API-key and per-collection-permission parts of the story, and the docs also mention TLS and audit logging. missing for 10: roles are only implied through key types (no named role or RBAC model is documented), no detail on how granular scoping is configured or enforced, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
